mapper.select: select l.log_id, l.order_id, l.order_no, l.action, l.action_label, l.operator_id, coalesce(nullif(u.nick_name, ''), l.operator_name) as operator_name, l.content, l.create_time from prop_repair_order_log l left join sys_user u on u.user_id = l.operator_id and u.del_flag = '0' where l.order_id = #{orderId} order by l.create_time desc, l.log_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into prop_repair_order_log(order_id, order_no, action, action_label, operator_id, operator_name, content, create_time) values(#{orderId}, #{orderNo}, #{action}, #{actionLabel}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, #{content}, sysdate())
